item.tib: bsnyan rgyud a dkar sems kyi me long
item.coloph: kun bzang thugs kyi yang bcud/ bla chen dgongs pa'i man ngag skal ldan rnams kyi dngos grub/ 'di ni snyan rgyud sems kyi lde mig don gyi khog dbub/ snyan rgyud 'khrul 'khor me long gi don gyis (gyi) gag bsal/ a dkar sgron me'i las kyi don bsdus/ ces pa dag bsdus pa'i dgongs pa/ snyan rgyud a dkar sems kyi me long zhes bya ba/ 'o sgom blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis yi ger bskod (bkod)pa rdzogs so//
